_coverageThresholdRationale: Floors were recalibrated after the Community Web client extraction: the old 85/85 line and statement floors were set when the web surfaces were single emitted template-literal modules, so their giant style/markup strings counted as covered lines and inflated the totals. The vite-compiled client entry (Epoch.Community.Web/dist/client/*) executes only inside Playwright and is invisible to c8, so it is excluded with the workbench/search bundles. Remaining Node-visible actuals after that exclude sit near 89/86/78 for lines/functions/branches. Floors sit 1-2 points below those actuals (lines/statements ratchet 78→87). Function coverage stays at 85 until history/fuzz work covers more store methods.
